Shubham K Mart Digital Brand Guidelines

Canonical Brand Palette
Brand green | #39823C | Primary brand surface
Brand gold | #F3CB2D | Energy & emphasis
Deep green | #214B32 | Text on gold
Ink | #192C20 | Primary text
Cream | #FBFAF4 | Warm surface
White | #FFFFFF | Base surface

Campaign & Promotion Inspiration Palette
Tangerine Orange | #FF941A | Festive & Sale Promotions | Discounts, clearance banners and festive energy
Crimson Sale Red | #E63946 | Bold Sale & Urgency | Limited-time discounts, flash deals and clearance alerts
Soft Fresh Mint | #D9F7E5 | Fresh & Natural Grocery | Grocery, organic products, health, wellness and soft backgrounds
Charcoal Slate | #111827 | High-Contrast Typography | Bold sale announcements, clearance headers and minimal UI
Forest Deep Green | #1B5E20 | Premium & Elegant | Luxury product presentation, 3D cylinder podiums and brand campaigns
Golden Cream | #FFF7D6 | Podium & Warm Glow | Podium surfaces, softer backgrounds and cosmetic presentation
Digital Purple | #7C3AED | Trendy & Modern Digital | Youthful creatives, app promotions and digital tech graphics
Digital Sky Blue | #38BDF8 | Modern Digital Accents | Youthful app highlights, digital rewards and modern banners
Fresh Mint Green | #A7E3A1 | Fresh Mint Transitions | Gradient stops, nature transitions and fresh produce accents

Category Complementary Palette (Promotional Canvas Only)
Chilli Red | #D8232A | Noodles, pasta & soups | Instant food flavor & warmth
Sunrise Orange | #F37021 | Breakfast cereals & oats | Morning vitality & energy
Confectionery Lilac | #9678B6 | Chocolates & sweets | Sweet gifting & indulgence
Rich Cocoa | #3D1E16 | Confectionery & bakery | Deep cocoa rich backdrop
Terracotta Earth | #C86D51 | Dry fruits & nuts | Natural harvest crunch
Deep Plum | #3E162F | Seeds & superfoods | Wholesome seed mixes
School Cyan | #00A3E0 | Stationery & notebooks | Student clarity & focus

5 Curated Color Combinations
Fresh & Natural (Grocery & Organic): Brand Green #39823C, Brand Gold #F3CB2C, Soft Mint #D9F7E5, Pure White #FFFFFF | Best for grocery, organic products, health and wellness.
Bold Sale & Promotions (Sale & Offers): Brand Gold #F3CB2C, Tangerine Orange #FF941A, Crimson Red #E63946, Charcoal Slate #111827 | Best for discounts, limited-time offers and clearance banners.
Premium & Elegant (Premium & Luxury): Forest Green #1B5E20, Brand Gold #F3CB2C, Charcoal Slate #111827, Golden Cream #FFF7D6 | Best for premium products, brand campaigns and elegant graphics.
Trendy & Modern (Apps & Tech): Brand Green #39823C, Digital Purple #7C3AED, Brand Gold #F3CB2C, Sky Blue #38BDF8 | Best for youthful creatives, app promotions and digital campaigns.
Minimal & Clean (Clean Layouts): Pure White #FFFFFF, Soft Mint #D9F7E5, Brand Green #39823C, Charcoal Slate #111827 | Best for clean layouts, product cards and professional website graphics.

5 Banner Gradient Styles
Signature brand gradient: Brand Gold → Brand Green (#F3CB2C → #39823C) | CSS: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3CB2C 0%, #39823C 100%) | Primary brand banners, hero backdrops and signature identity surfaces.
Festive energy: Tangerine Orange → Crimson Red (#FF941A → #E63946) | CSS: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF941A 0%, #E63946 100%) | Festival campaigns, flash sale banners, clearance alerts and high-energy promotions.
Fresh mint: Brand Green → Fresh Mint Green (#39823C → #A7E3A1) | CSS: linear-gradient(135deg, #39823C 0%, #A7E3A1 100%) | Fresh fruits & vegetables, organic groceries, dairy and morning wellness.
Modern digital: Digital Purple → Sky Blue (#7C3AED → #38BDF8) | CSS: linear-gradient(135deg, #7C3AED 0%, #38BDF8 100%) | App promotions, tech accessories, digital payment rewards and youth campaigns.
Golden premium: Brand Gold → Golden Cream (#F3CB2C → #FFF7D6) | CSS: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3CB2C 0%, #FFF7D6 100%) | Cosmetic product presentation, luxury gift packs, gourmet foods and 3D podiums.

Which Palette Should You Use? Selection Matrix
Everyday brand banners | Yellow + Green + White | #F3CB2C · #39823C · #FFFFFF | Core website banners, permanent app UI, standard retail headers.
Grocery and fresh food | Green + Mint + Yellow | #39823C · #D9F7E5 · #F3CB2C | Fresh fruits, vegetables, dairy, grains and health & wellness.
Festival campaigns | Yellow + Orange + Red + Dark Green | #F3CB2C · #FF941A · #E63946 · #1B5E20 | Diwali, festive season, celebration hampers and cultural promotions.
Big sale announcements | Yellow + Red + Charcoal | #F3CB2C · #E63946 · #111827 | End-of-season clearance, mega discounts, flash sale countdowns.
Premium product graphics | Dark Green + Gold + Cream | #1B5E20 · #F3CB2C · #FFF7D6 | Gourmet selections, 3D cylinder podiums, luxury cosmetic presentation.
Modern app or tech graphics | Green + Purple + Sky Blue | #39823C · #7C3AED · #38BDF8 | Digital feature updates, mobile app promotions, youth campaigns.
Minimal website sections | White + Mint + Green | #FFFFFF · #D9F7E5 · #39823C | Clean product cards, checkout flows, policy pages and uncluttered layouts.

Brand Identity Recommendation
Keep yellow and green consistent as your brand identity. Introduce orange and red for festive campaigns and sales, purple or blue for special creative concepts, and cream or mint for softer backgrounds. This gives you variety without making your brand look inconsistent.

Welcome to the brand
A familiar identity, wherever we show up. The shared design language for everyone building and creating for Shubham K Mart.

Mission & personality
Make digital shopping feel clear, useful and dependable. Our identity connects a warm local voice with a consistent digital experience.
Mission: Quality and value: Become a preferred name through quality products and accessible prices. Adapted from the mission described in the supplied PDF.
Vision: A rewarding experience: Create a gratifying shopping experience for Indian customers. Adapted from the vision described in the supplied PDF.
Digital expression: Familiar at every tap: Help people find relevant information, understand the next step and recognize the brand across screens.
Approachable: Warm surfaces, readable layouts and familiar, respectful words.
Assured: Strong alignment and clear statements supported by evidence.
Energetic: Gold accents, confident type and light wit when appropriate.
Responsible: Accurate information and accountable service language.

Two colors. One brand symbol.
The logo is our official brand mark. Choose the yellow logo for Brand Green #39823C and the green logo for Brand Gold #F3CB2D. Each color is available as transparent SVG and transparent PNG masters. The named wordmark logo is not permitted.
Logo only: Use the official logo exclusively across all brand surfaces. Do not use any named or wordmark logo lockups.
Yellow logo on Brand Green: Place the yellow logo only on the solid Brand Green surface #39823C. Do not place it on gold, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.
Green logo on Brand Gold: Place the green logo only on the solid Brand Gold surface #F3CB2D. Do not place it on green, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.
Artwork colors: Brand Green #39823C is our primary brand surface. The logo artwork uses the authentic yellow and green palette. Always maintain high contrast and pure brand backgrounds.
Transparent masters: Both SVG and 2160 × 2160 PNG formats are available for both colorways. Transparent means the background is removed to sit cleanly on solid Brand Green or Brand Gold surfaces.
No named logo or wordmark: Do not include or reconstruct named logos or typography with the symbol. The standalone logo represents the brand.
Never alter the mark: Do not stretch, rotate, crop, add outlines, recolor, add drop shadows or modify the logo artwork.
File | Logo version | Permitted background | Use
logo-bag-only-yellow-transparent.svg | Yellow logo · transparent | Brand Green #39823C only | Primary digital headers, brand tiles, digital web banners, and app UI.
logo-bag-only-green-transparent.svg | Green logo · transparent | Brand Gold #F3CB2D only | Gold digital headers, campaign panels, app promotional banners and navigation.

The right logo in every format
Select the logo by its background first, then place it on the format grid. Transparent yellow logo belongs on Brand Green only; transparent green logo belongs on Brand Gold only. Keep the brand anchor consistent within each template.
Choose the surface first: Use only #39823C behind the yellow logo and #F3CB2D behind the green logo.
Exact digital sizes: Desktop header: 44 px height (33 px width). Mobile header / app bar: 36 px height (27 px width). Digital web banners & app banners (1080 × 600 px): 110 × 145 px mark (48 px inset). OG share cards (1200 × 630 px): 115 × 152 px mark (64 px inset).
Clear space: Proposed minimum: 0.25 × the symbol width on each side. Measure from the visible mark rather than empty SVG canvas.
Minimum size: Absolute minimum 32 px symbol height for compact digital UI and 64 px or larger for digital campaign layouts.
Responsive placement: Recompose the layout for narrow screens. Preserve the symbol aspect ratio, readable size and clear space; never stretch the image to fill a container.
Digital surface & size | Logo & theme selection | Placement & safe inset | Production check
Website / app header · 1440 × 90 / 390 × 64 px | Brand Green #39823C header: yellow logo. Brand Gold #F3CB2D header: green logo. | Left content-grid anchor; 24 px desktop / 16 px mobile inset. | Desktop symbol: 44 px height (33 px width); Mobile symbol: 36 px height (27 px width); 32 px absolute minimum.
Digital web banner · 1080 × 600 px | Brand Green #39823C canvas with yellow logo. | Top-left; proposed 48 px inset. | Render mark at 110 × 145 px; primary desktop web and campaign banner; keep mark and headline legible in crop.
App banner · 1080 × 600 px | Brand Gold #F3CB2D canvas with green logo (or Brand Green #39823C pairing). | Top-left; proposed 48 px inset. | Render mark at 110 × 145 px; in-app carousel and category promotions; 48 px safe touch boundary.
Open Graph / Social preview · 1200 × 630 px | Brand Green #39823C canvas with yellow logo (or Brand Gold #F3CB2D pairing). | Top-left; proposed 64 px inset. | Render mark at 115 × 152 px; standard 1.91:1 sharing preview card for digital sharing and chat previews.
Photography / mixed artwork | Create a solid Brand Green or Brand Gold panel for its matching transparent logo. | Align the brand plate to the content grid. | Never place the transparent mark directly over an image or unapproved surface.

The colors of familiarity
Green builds recognition. Gold brings energy. Warm neutrals give content room. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value. Explore campaign color combinations, banner gradients, and promotional guidelines below.
Brand identity anchor: Keep yellow (#F3CB2D / #F3CB2C) and green (#39823C) consistent as your core brand identity across every consumer touchpoint.
Campaign & promotional palette: Introduce Tangerine Orange (#FF941A) and Crimson Red (#E63946) for festive campaigns, clearance banners, and high-urgency promotional graphics.
Category & soft backgrounds: Use Soft Fresh Mint (#D9F7E5) or Golden Cream (#FFF7D6) for softer backgrounds in grocery, organic, wellness, and luxury presentation.
Modern digital accents: Introduce Digital Purple (#7C3AED) and Sky Blue (#38BDF8) for modern app graphics, tech accessories, digital payments, and youth-oriented creatives.
Banner gradients: Use purposeful two-stop linear gradients (Signature Brand, Festive Energy, Fresh Mint, Modern Digital, Golden Premium) while preserving high contrast and legible typography.
Brand anchor requirement: Every campaign creative, promotional banner, or category graphic must feature the official Shubham K Mart brand anchor with its designated background (yellow logo on Brand Green, or green logo on Brand Gold).

Clear words. Confident type.
Inter is the proposed shared family for Latin text. Primary headlines use Bold or ExtraBold. Secondary body copy uses Regular. UI labels use Medium or SemiBold. These are different roles within the same font family.
English + Hinglish: Use natural phrasing and sentence case. Avoid extended all-caps paragraphs.
Regional scripts: Noto Sans Devanagari is proposed for Hindi. Confirm suitable script fonts for Gujarati and Odia before release.
Proof every language: Review matras, Unicode shaping, line breaks, spelling and text expansion with a regional editor.
Role | Desktop / mobile | Weight / line height
Display | 48–56 / 34–40 px | 700–800 / 1.15
H1 | 36 / 28 px | 700 / 1.2
H2 | 28 / 24 px | 700 / 1.2
H3 | 22 / 20 px | 600 / 1.25
Body | 16 / 16 px | 400 / 1.5
Support | 14 / 14 px | 400–500 / 1.5
Price | 22–28 / 20–24 px | 700 / 1.2

Sound like someone familiar
Speak like a thoughtful shopping companion who respects people’s time. Lead with usefulness and keep every promise grounded in confirmed facts.
Everyday: “Ghar ki list, ab thodi easier.”: Friendly and natural. Use English or Hinglish to suit the audience.
Festival: “Make room for moments together.”: Thoughtful and culturally relevant. Have a regional editor review the final copy.
Service: “We’re checking your order.”: Precise and accountable. Share dates or response times only when confirmed.
Brand spelling: Always write Shubham K Mart in consumer-facing text. SKM belongs in clear internal or technical contexts.
Existing tagline: Shopping karo khulke, paise bachao jamke! Campaign headlines support this line rather than replace it.
Copy structure: Start with a verified fact, connect it to a familiar situation, explain the benefit and offer one relevant next step.
Claims: Avoid unverified cheapest-ever statements, fabricated urgency and universal availability promises.

A little structure goes far
Build around a clear headline, one focal visual and a useful next step. Align every element to a shared grid instead of filling every gap.
Creative hierarchy: Brand anchor → headline → relevant visual → action → legible terms.
Density: One dominant message per panel. Leave quiet space around the headline.
Small screens: Stack content by reading priority. Avoid shrinking a desktop composition into a narrow screen.
Foundation | Proposed standard | Use
Spacing | 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64 px | 8 px base with 4 px substeps.
Content width | Approximately 1200 px | Centered content area with responsive page padding.
Radius | 8 / 12 / 16 px | Controls, cards and larger containers.
Grid | 12 desktop / 4 mobile columns | Consistent content alignment. Proposed implementation extension.
Primary button | 48 px height | Keep the label short and meaningful.
Touch target | Recommended 44 × 44 px | Separate adjacent controls and keep focus visible.

Images people can trust
Use authorized product images and purposeful illustrations. Every visual should help someone understand the category or message.
Use: Accurate product imagery: Keep labels, proportions, pack sizes and colors faithful to the approved catalogue asset.
Compose: One focal point: Leave clean space for the headline. Use consistent image scale and a restrained background.
Describe: Meaningful alternatives: Write alt text for informative imagery. Decorative details get an empty alt attribute.
Illustrations: Abstract editorial illustrations may support a concept. They cannot establish that an item is available.
Image exports: Use SVG for approved vector marks. Choose appropriately sized WebP / AVIF for raster web images and PNG when transparency matters.
Quality: Avoid compressed screenshots, altered product labels and busy collages that compete with the message.

Small details, shared rhythm
Choose a coherent icon family and motion that helps people understand a change. Keep the interface responsive and the content easy to follow.
Iconography: 2 px outlines: Use one coherent outline family with consistent optical sizing. Avoid mixing unrelated styles.
Fast feedback: 150 ms: Use for button feedback, hover states and small functional changes.
Standard transition: 250 ms: Use for panels and interface transitions. Avoid delays before essential content.
Purpose: Motion communicates feedback or orientation. Keep content visible and useful when animations are disabled.
Reduced motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and remove nonessential movement.
Icon labels: Keep text labels on unfamiliar actions. Decorative icons should not create duplicate screen-reader announcements.

A brand everyone can use
The supplied guide proposes WCAG 2.2 AA as a target. Use these checks during design and development, followed by testing with real content and assistive technology.
Perception: Provide meaningful alt text, readable contrast, text scaling and responsive reflow.
Keyboard: Support logical Tab order, a visible focus indicator and usable controls without a pointer.
Understanding: Use explicit labels, specific errors and clear status messages. Do not rely only on color.
Touch & regional text: Aim for 44 × 44 px mobile targets and test regional scripts on actual devices.
Verification: A checklist does not establish conformance. Test screen readers, zoom, keyboard access and reduced-motion behavior.
Pair | Contrast | Use
White on brand green | 4.74:1 | Suitable for normal-size text.
Deep green on gold | 6.33:1 | Suitable for normal-size text.
Gold on brand green | 3.02:1 | Use for qualifying large text; avoid small functional copy.
White on gold | 1.57:1 | Avoid for functional text.

Small canvas. Clear impact.
A strong banner is a focused composition. Give the headline priority, keep the logo readable and adapt the layout to its actual placement. Both digital web banners and app banners share the 1080 × 600 px canvas with 48 px safe insets.
Margins & safe zones: For 1080 × 600 web and app banners, start with 48 px safe insets. Keep all essential copy and logos inside them.
Themes & contrast: Digital web banners default to Brand Green #39823C (yellow logo, white headline). In-app promotional banners default to Brand Gold #F3CB2D (green logo, Deep Green #214B32 headline). Category banners use complementary category themes with a clear brand anchor.
Category complementary colors: In category campaigns, use appetizing, culturally relevant background colors (e.g., Chilli Red for noodles, Sunrise Orange for breakfast, Confectionery Lilac for sweets).
Action: One descriptive action leading to a working, relevant destination.
Performance: Export at the required display density, set dimensions and avoid oversized raster files.
Truth: Show only verified claims and relevant categories. Never place unreadable conditions below a large promise.
Asset & theme | Dimensions & safe inset | Use & specifications
Digital web banner · Brand Green | 1080 × 600 px · 48 px inset | Primary website header and campaign banner. Uses Brand Green #39823C background with yellow logo.
App banner · Brand Gold | 1080 × 600 px · 48 px inset | Mobile app carousel and category promotions. Uses Brand Gold #F3CB2D background with green logo.
Category banners · Complementary palettes | 1080 × 600 px · 48 px inset | Retail promotional banners using category-specific mood colors (Chilli Red, Sunrise Orange, Lilac/Cocoa, Terracotta, Cyan) with brand anchor.
Social sharing image · Open Graph | 1200 × 630 px · 64 px inset | Open Graph preview card; ensures crisp rendering across social and chat previews.
Responsive alternate · Narrow crop | Placement-specific · 24 px inset | Create a separate narrow composition when responsive mobile viewports crop horizontal content.

The brand, made usable
Connect the brand system to useful interfaces. Predictable navigation, readable information and clear states matter on every screen.
Responsive foundation: Keep body text at 16 px, use flexible columns and test reflow at narrow widths and enlarged text.
Crawlable pages: Render meaningful content in the initial HTML, use real anchor links and give every useful page its own descriptive URL and metadata.
Honest UX copy: Describe the current state and the next step. Avoid fabricated dates, hidden conditions or misleading button labels.
Component | Required states | Design behavior
Navigation & search | Default, focus, results, loading, empty | Clear labels, visible focus and a predictable content grid.
Buttons & links | Default, hover, focus, disabled, loading | One clear primary action. Explain a disabled action when needed.
Form fields | Label, help, focus, error, success | Persistent labels and specific, recoverable errors.
Content cards | Default, loading, unavailable | Accurate copy and image dimensions reserved to avoid layout shift.
Status messages | Informative, success, error | Use words or icons alongside color; announce updates accessibly.

Content with a useful role
Plan content around everyday needs, category discovery and digital confidence. The supplied mix is an initial planning hypothesis, not a performance benchmark.
35%: Everyday utility: Household lists, helpful routines and practical planning.
25%: Category discovery: Useful category information based on actual catalogue content.
20%: Family & culture: Regional moments, thoughtful relevance and local language.
10%: Digital service & trust: Search guidance, availability explanations and confirmed support information.
10%: Approved campaigns: A verified message with valid dates and an appropriate destination.
Brief: Record audience, objective, channel, region and one central message.
Localize: Transcreate meaning rather than translate word for word. Have a regional editor proof the final creative.
Review: Use actual channel results to adjust the mix. Record what worked and archive expired campaign material.

A thoughtful interruption
Use direct channels with care. Routine messages should be warm, brief and relevant, with readable content and a clear reason to exist.
Routine notification: Ghar ki list ready?: Roz ki chhoti-badi zarooraton ko ek jagah dekho. Editorial sample from the supplied deck.
Support template: We’re checking order [ID].: We’ll share an update by [CONFIRMED TIME]. Resolve every bracketed field before sending.
Email layout: One clear message: Use a compact approved logo, readable text, one relevant action and plain contact information.
Routine titles: Keep titles at 30 characters maximum with no explicit routine CTA or pressure-led offer language.
Consent & timing: Check the intended audience, consent, frequency and approved send time. Offer campaigns follow separate review.
Email usability: Provide useful alt text, visible links and a plain-text alternative. Keep the message understandable when images are blocked.

A shared source of truth
Use semantic values across CSS, JSON, design tools and components. These proposed tokens reproduce the digital system described in the source deck.
Semantic usage: Use brand.green for brand expression and text.primary for body text. Avoid scattered one-off HEX values.
Typography: Inter for Latin text. Load a suitable approved script font for each regional locale.
Interaction: Use 48 px primary buttons, recommended 44 px touch targets and visible focus states.
Responsive values: Use the shared scale while allowing the composition to adapt to its content and viewport.

The right starting files
Download the official vector artwork, transparent yellow and green logos, proposed design tokens and editable digital web and app banner layout templates. Templates use the official logo without redrawing it.
Official logos: The yellow and green logo SVG files retain their authentic vector paths, shading and colors. Transparent yellow and green variants are available as SVG and PNG.
Template status: The web banner, app banner and Open Graph templates are proposed editable layouts featuring the official logo. Check current platform crops and final copy before release.
Transparent PNG and SVG downloads: The logo is available as supplied 2160 × 2160 PNG files and SVG vector masters. Choose PNG for raster workflows and SVG for scalable digital layouts. The same background and placement rules apply to both formats.
Transparent logo backgrounds: Yellow transparent: Brand Green #39823C only. Green transparent: Brand Gold #F3CB2D only. Never place on white, cream, black or arbitrary backgrounds.
Naming: Use skm-campaign-name-channel-locale-v01. Keep a clear version and locale for every creative.

Ready for the next screen
Give every digital release a focused final review. Use the checklist below for the current session, then record the evidence with the release.
Owner record: Track approved copy, scope, evidence, owner, verified date, approval status and next review date.
Workflow: Brief and design → copy review → factual checks → QA → approval → publish → monitor.
Version status: The supplied source standards are marked proposed v1.0. Formal brand approval remains a separate step from making this guide.
Original logo, correct spelling and consistent placement
Proposed palette and typography applied consistently
Clear-space, safe-area and mobile crop reviewed
Images authorized and final copy proofread
Claims, dates and category details confirmed
Contrast, keyboard focus and alt text reviewed
Destination links and responsive layouts checked
Version, locale, owner and review date recorded
